description: Norges Bank daily exchange rate of one foreign currency in NOK (NOK per 1 unit of the currency), from Norges Bank's SDMX-JSON data API. Last N observations; business days only. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_coincap_fiat_fx_rates when you need exchange rates against the US dollar for about 170 fiat. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
